questions: Is applyConnectedState() called from a worker thread or the main thread? The code structure suggests session management may involve worker threads based on m_connectThread/m_disconnectThread references.
Should m_channelCount be std::atomic<uint32_t> with proper memory ordering to ensure visibility between threads?
What is the intended concurrency model for m_supportGeneration - should it be protected by a mutex or made atomic?
nits: Consider using std::memory_order_seq_cst for the m_connected.load() or document why acquire is sufficient given the other unsynchronized accesses
The ECUIO_SUPPORT_MAX_DROPPED constant (8) matches the array size, but consider adding a static_assert to verify the struct layout assumptions
